title: Hymn index prints '28/12 L' for two hymns that the body gives to 28/8 and 28/10: re-code them?
prompt:
The Index hymnorum prints day code 28/12 (Holy Innocents), hour L, for two hymns that the body of the book gives to OTHER 28ths:
- #83 'Commune vos apostoli' (LHym 459, p1216): the body prints it only on p918, 'Die 28: Ss. Simonis et Iudae' (28 Oct), Laudes H.
- #130 'Fulget in cælis' (LHym 424, p1217): the body prints it only on p863, 'Die 28: S. Augustini' (28 Aug), 'Laudes & Vesp.' H.
Holy Innocents (pp968-969) prints Off. lect. 'Hymnum canentes martyrum (LHym 484)' and Laudes 'Audit tyrannus anxius (LHym 485)'. 'Audit tyrannus' (gregobase:8423) already holds holy-innocents LAUDS.hymn, so both rows are held as conflicts. The month is misprinted in the book's own index; this is not a parse error. Re-code them from the body pages?

pages.note: Ss. Simon & Jude, Laudes H Commune vos apostoli
S. Augustine, Laudes & Vesp. H Fulget in cælis

options.label: Re-code from the body
options.detail: #83 → simon-and-jude LAUDS.hymn; #130 → st-augustine LAUDS.hymn + VESPERS.hymn (as p863 prints). Index override of day_code (28/10, 28/8; #130 hour L+V), notes cite the body page; nothing on holy-innocents

options.label: Drop the 28/12 target only
options.detail: load nothing for these rows; their body pages stay unrepresented

options.label: Load on holy-innocents as further options
options.detail: follows the index literally; contradicted by pp968-969
